system.description:
The pickpockets of Mournas's lower districts, Opal's markets and any crowded city: not a guild member, just someone who learned the city's pockets before learning to read.

  • Lost in the Crowd: right after a Pick Pocket in a crowd, success or not, you may Hide at once even while watched, and a crowd of 10 or more counts as cover for you. Your Snatch can take any item that isn't held in a hand or worn as armour.
    • 9th level: when your Exploit hit is a critical hit, your Snatch can take an item held in a hand.
  • Back Alley Economics: Advantage on checks to fence stolen goods, value loot on the black market, and find a city's back streets and shortcuts.
